result.question: How much cash and cash equivalents did Apple report at the end of fiscal 2025?
result.answer: Apple reported $35,934 million (approximately $35.9 billion) in cash and cash equivalents at the end of fiscal 2025, as of September 27, 2025 [0000320193-25-000077:ex-99-press-release-p003]. This figure is confirmed by the XBRL fact for CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue as of 2025-09-27, which reports 35,934,000,000 USD [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue:2025-09-27]. The consolidated statements of cash flows in the 10-K also show ending cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash and cash equivalents of $35,934 million for the year ended September 27, 2025 [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p003].
